full_name: L. Mahadevan | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Biological Sciences Audrey, Fay, Katherine, and Megan Shutzer Fellow for Science Harvard University
bio: L. Mahadevan is the Lola England de Valpine Professor of Applied Mathematics, a professor of physics and of organismic and evolutionary biology, and a core member of the Wyss Institute for Biologically Inspired Engineering, all at Harvard University. His work centers on using mathematics to understand the physical and biological organization of matter in space and time, particularly at the scale of the everyday world.
